data.body:
[P2] Keep engine availability validation from blocking teardown

`cdk destroy` also executes this app to synthesize its cloud assembly. Once RDS stops offering the configured minor version, this unconditional check throws and `main().catch` exits before deletion starts. Consequently, the documented teardown command fails and leaves the deployed demo resources running, even though deleting them requires no available engine version. Bypass this check during teardown, and add an app-level regression test covering destruction with an unavailable configured version.
